summary.en-US: Read Japanese on any page with furigana, pitch accent, pop-up definitions, subtitles, OCR, and a study page.
summary.ja: ウェブページの日本語にふりがなとピッチアクセントを付け、辞書ポップアップ、字幕、OCR、学習ページで読解を助けます。

version.approval_notes: No account is required for core review. Yomu does not declare a new-tab override or redirect new tabs; the browser's own new-tab page remains unchanged. Select the Yomu toolbar icon and choose Open Study to open the bundled Study app deliberately. A fresh card starts at its first enabled learning step (Kanji 1 by default). During first-run setup, Japanese text on webpages offers three explicit choices: leave pages unchanged, scan Japanese automatically, or scan only when requested. On a Japanese page, select a word to open the bundled dictionary popup. All executable JavaScript and CSS is packaged, and the bundled fflate MIT notice is included. Firefox declares websiteContent as required and authenticationInfo as optional. The native authenticationInfo request happens directly from Save on the bundled Study settings page. Credential saves and settings imports fail closed on ordinary webpages, where Firefox does not expose the permissions API. The Bunpro page helper does not read its token in the Firefox extension and opens Study settings instead. Denial leaves the credential unsaved and the integration off. Other optional network services are used only when the user enables or invokes them.
